summary: Frontend-only testing of Quantum Calculator (Expo web preview). All 17 review scenarios pass end-to-end at the public EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. App loads at /, redirects to /(tabs)/calculator. Bottom tabs Calculator/History/Reference all navigate. All 5 operation chips (multiply_matrix, apply_gate, normalize_vector, tensor_product, measure) switch correctly. Grid<->JSON toggle works. Default identity*identity computes successfully. Sample multiply A=[[1,2],[3,4]] B=[[2,0],[1,2]] correctly yields [[4,4],[10,8]]. Normalize v=[3,4] yields [0.6, 0.8]. apply_gate H on [1,0] yields [0.7071, 0.7071]. All 8 gate chips (H,X,Y,Z,I,S,T,CNOT) render and are selectable. measure produces histogram with two bars |0⟩ and |1⟩ (~512 each on 1024 shots). Complex numbers work in both grid ('1+2i') and JSON ('[["1+i","2"],["0","i"]]') modes. Error handling: mismatched-dim multiply (2x3 · 2x2) shows error-box with helpful message 'Cannot multiply: A is 2x3 but B is 2x2. Inner dims must match (3 ≠ 2).' History tab accumulates entries (timestamp + op label) after each compute; clear-history-btn empties to history-empty state. Reference tab lists all 5 ops and all 8 gates with matrix displays. R/C steppers add cells correctly. Result rendering shows cyan vertical bracket bars and uses testIDs result-card/result-matrix/result-vector/result-histogram. Two minor non-blocking React Native web warnings observed (deprecated style props in vendor code).

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' Emitted on web — likely from styles using shadowColor/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius/shadowOffset (see /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/calculator.tsx computeBtn styles ~line 774-777 and /app/frontend/src/components/Histogram.tsx bar style ~line 109-111). Non-blocking but should migrate to boxShadow for web or guard with Platform.select.

Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Coming from a dependency (likely react-native-safe-area-context or expo-router internals). Non-blocking; monitor for upstream fix.

action_items: (Optional) Replace shadow* props with boxShadow (or Platform.select) in calculator.tsx computeBtn and Histogram.tsx bar to silence web deprecation warning.
(Optional) Bump expo@54.0.34 -> ~54.0.35, expo-font@14.0.11 -> ~14.0.12, expo-router@6.0.23 -> ~6.0.24 per Expo doctor (warning printed at startup, app still works).
No functional fixes required — all features in the review request pass.
critical_code_review_comments: calculator.tsx is 825 lines — close to the 700-line soft limit. Consider splitting input panels (matrix A/B grid, vector grid, JSON fields, gate picker) into separate components for maintainability.

switchMode() in calculator.tsx has a redundant double-set of setVGrid (line 119 then 121). The first set with JSON.stringify on Complex is dead code overwritten on the next line — should remove the dead line.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Pure client-side Expo app. Public URL is EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env. Use mobile viewport 390x844. Critical testIDs to drive flows: tab-calculator/history/reference, op-{multiply_matrix|apply_gate|normalize_vector|tensor_product|measure}, mode-grid/mode-json, sample-btn, compute-btn, a-cell-{r}-{c}, b-cell-{r}-{c}, v-cell-{r}-0, a-json/b-json/v-json, gate-{H|X|Y|Z|I|S|T|CNOT}, shots-input, error-box, result-card/result-matrix/result-vector/result-histogram, clear-history-btn, hist-bar-|0⟩/|1⟩. Note: grids do NOT reset when switching ops, so tensor_product after a multiply sample will use prior A/B values — this is expected behavior.
rca_of_issue: No bugs found in the implementation.
